Name: CUTSCENE_GPARAM_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Picks the time of day shown during a cutscene from the in-game time when it starts. Row ID = cutscene ID (s10_00_0010 → 10000010); a cutscene without its own row uses row 0. The in-game hour falls into one of seven time zones (CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam rows 0–6); the matching field here names the zone whose Cutscene Time is used while the cutscene plays.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Debug
Fields.Description: Marks debug-only rows. Appears unused by the game (off on every retail row).

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Morning
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Morning zone (CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam row 0; retail 5:45–8:30). The value is a CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam row (0–6) whose Cutscene Time is the hour shown during the cutscene; 7 or more shows hour 0. Retail defaults keep each zone (0 → 0 … 6 → 6) or force one zone, e.g. 4 for night.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Noon
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Noon zone (row 1; retail 8:30–12:30). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Afternoon
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Afternoon zone (row 2; retail 12:30–16:30). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Evening
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Evening zone (row 3; retail 16:30–19:30). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Night
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Night zone (row 4; retail 19:30–1:30). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Deep Night A
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Deep Night A zone (row 5; retail 1:30–3:00). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Destination Timezone: Deep Night B
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Deep Night B zone (row 6; retail 3:00–5:45). Same values as Destination Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Post Cutscene In-game Time
Fields.Description: In-game clock time set when the cutscene ends, in hours (22.5 = 22:30). Cut to whole minutes; the hour is capped at 23 and the minute at 59. Below 0: the clock is not changed. Retail: -1 on most rows, 22.5 on 11.
